display_name: The Orbit-Flow Corridor / 軌道循環回廊
summary: A perpetual-motion district where luck and data circulate at terminal velocity through a labyrinth of neon-lit arteries. Here, the journey is the only destination, and existence is defined by the seamless transition between arrival and departure.

functional_logic.scenario: Long-exposure light trails of automated pods cutting through vertical chrome monoliths under high-contrast cyan moonlight.

core_cast.name: Miss Madi
core_cast.trait: A patient but mathematically precise guide who bridges the gap between raw machine logic and human navigation; she is the first voice heard by those lost in the automated sprawl.

core_cast.name: Mammon Manager
core_cast.trait: Pragmatic and ruthlessly efficient; he views luck as a quantifiable asset and manages the flow of personal finances with the cold competence of a high-speed trading engine.

functional_logic.rule:
Stagnation is a Civil Offense; all entities must remain in kinetic or digital flux.
The Great Algorithm dictates the right-of-way; intuition must yield to the automated path.

production_dna.visual_anchor: Long-exposure light trails of automated pods cutting through vertical chrome monoliths under high-contrast cyan moonlight.
